periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree diagonal tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis, extending from the inner canthus toward the outer cheek.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High eccentricity oval; longitudinal axis is roughly twice the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the lower mandibular region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep V-shaped curvature at the posterior midline vertex.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness at the lateral flanks, occupying approximately 30% of the visible dorsal-to-lateral span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation; distance is roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semicircular convex curvature at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent ivory-colored claws visible on the left posterior limb.
